title: Sageling - the free, local AI assistant for real work
excerpt: Private by default, with no usage limits. Sageling works on your files, on your Mac.
content_html:
Sageling helps you get
real work done.

It's your everyday assistant that lives on your computer.
It doesn't send your work to the cloud, the internet, anywhere - unless you ask it to.
It's private.

A different kind of assistant

It runs on your Mac.

Keeps your data safe

Private by default.

Sageling doesn't upload any of your files, folders to us or anyone else. It can if you ask it to!

We don't store your conversations or share them. It's safe to use with your sensitive data.

Keep going

Never runs out.

Have a lot of work to get done? No problem, Sageling will keep running until the job is done.

Since it runs on your Mac, you never have to worry about usage limits. Just keep working till the job is done.

Made for the work you already do

It makes repetitive work easier.

Built for daily tasks

Designed for you, not software developers.

Most AI tools assume you’re a software wizard. Sageling assumes you have work to get done.

Describe what you want in your own words, or choose a skill and fill in a simple brief.

It will help you even get the work you're not sure how to do done.

Trust it with your work

Questions people ask

Does my work leave my Mac?

No. Your conversations, files, and memories stay on your Mac, and Sageling calls no outside AI service. The network is used only when a job needs the web, for downloads, and for a rating you choose to send.

Privacy and your data

Can I use it in my HIPAA-covered practice?

Yes, but you must still keep a HIPAA-compliant setup. You do not need a Business Associate Agreement with us, because we never have access to client information.

For health professionals

Does FERPA let me use it with student work?

Yes. Student work stays on your Mac and is never disclosed to us. Your institution’s software policy is the thing to check.

For teachers and professors

Does it risk attorney-client privilege?

No. There is no third party in the loop: the model runs on your Mac and sends nothing to us or to another AI provider.

For lawyers

Does Sageling learn from my work?

It does not train on it, and neither do we. It keeps short memories as plain text files on your disk, which you can read, edit, and delete.

How memories work

What Mac do I need?

An Apple silicon Mac with at least 16 GB of memory on macOS 13 or later. The first run downloads a model of about 8 GB.

Getting it running
